# Bazel targets that Bazel may skip as incompatible (--skip_incompatible_explicit_targets) without failing coverage.
# Format: GROUP<space>REGEX. GROUP is the shard group (linux, aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-apple-darwin,
# x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm, x86_64-pc-windows-msvc); REGEX must match the whole label. Blank lines and lines starting
# with # are ignored.

# Upstream's Windows cross-compilation test variants are incompatible with Linux and macOS hosts.
linux .*-windows-cross
aarch64-apple-darwin .*-windows-cross
x86_64-apple-darwin .*-windows-cross
# The Windows sandbox crates' unit-test binaries only build for Windows.
linux //codex-rs/windows-sandbox(-rs|-service):.*-bin-unit-tests
aarch64-apple-darwin //codex-rs/windows-sandbox(-rs|-service):.*-bin-unit-tests
x86_64-apple-darwin //codex-rs/windows-sandbox(-rs|-service):.*-bin-unit-tests

# The Windows groups start empty until a run shows what they skip.
